    SignPR: A Progressive Vector-Quantized Diffusion Framework for Sign
                        Language Production

                                                              In this work, we focus on the T2P task, aiming to gen-
                                                                   erate semantically consistent, motion-accurate, and tem-
Effect of Regional Diffusion Conditioning.  Table 7                                                                porally coherent sign pose sequences from text. We in-
shows that conditioning on text or semantic pose alone is                                                           troduced SignPR, a progressive diffusion framework that
insufficient; both semantic and text are needed. The inte-                                                                      jointly models the structural and temporal properties of
gration method also matters: simple concatenation yields                                                                 signing. Through structural progressive refinement with se-
moderate gains, whereas the cross-attention (CA) used in                                                         mantic and regional generation and temporal progressive re-
SignPR performs best.                                                           finement via block-wise causal inference, SignPR achieves
                                                               superior semantic consistency, motion accuracy, and tem-

ble 8, we vary the frames per block K in block-wise causal    show that our method achieves superior performance.
